description: Extract clean, LLM-ready Markdown, structured JSON, or Hybrid output from any public URL using CrispParse's deterministic 3-tier waterfall (static HTTP, headless JS render, and self-healing CSS selectors) with C2PA provenance.

api_key.description: Optional CrispParse Macaroon bearer token (overrides CRISPPARSE_API_KEY).

bypass_cache.description: Set true to bypass edge cache and force a fresh live extraction (defaults to false).

mode.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default), 'json' (structured fields/JSON-LD), or 'hybrid' (both Markdown and structured data).

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE Base USDC proof header (overrides CRISPPARSE_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE).

selectors.description: Optional map of field_name -> CSS selector (up to 30 fields). Automatically triggers Tier 2 JS rendering and Tier 3 self-healing selector recovery if needed.

url.description: The full http:// or https:// URL to extract.

name: crispparse_extract
